title: Cis-platin and trans-platin
caption: Pt(NH₃)₂Cl₂ is square planar, so it has two isomers. In cisplatin the two chlorides are next to each other (90°); in the trans isomer they are opposite (180°). Only cisplatin is an anticancer drug: it binds two neighbouring bases on one DNA strand.
alt: Two square planar platinum complexes: cis, with the chlorides at 90°, and trans, with them at 180°.
description: Cisplatin: Cl and Cl on adjacent corners of the square.
Transplatin: Cl and Cl on opposite corners.
